Gemini CLI documentation excerpt, NOT a captured executable help fixture.
Sources: https://geminicli.com/docs/cli/cli-reference/ and https://github.com/google-gemini/gemini-cli/blob/main/packages/cli/src/utils/sessionUtils.ts (retrieved 2026-09-10)

--version -v Show CLI version number and exit
--help -h Show help information
--model -m Model to use
--prompt -p Prompt text. Forces non-interactive mode.
--approval-mode Approval mode: default, auto_edit, yolo, plan
--yolo -y Auto-approve all actions. Deprecated; use --approval-mode=yolo.
--resume -r Resume a previous session. Use latest for most recent or index number.
--list-sessions List available sessions for the current project and exit
--delete-session Delete a session by index number

sessionUtils.ts resolveSession(resumeArg): Can be latest, a full UUID, or an index number (1-based).
